name: Sewer Tunnel, Intersection
desc1: This is a slimy sewer tunnel. A muddy stream of sewage flows through
desc2: grooves in the ground here. Bloated rat corpses and other, unnameable
desc3: things occasionally bob to the surface, and you are hard pressed to
desc4: keep down your lunch due to the rancid stench pervading the area. The
desc5: sewer is a filthy, unwholesome place, and it is hard to tell exactly
desc6: where you are in these labyrinthine passages.
